name: Website Rescue
who: Owners of small businesses who suspect their website is costing them work but have no way to tell whether that is true or which part is at fault.
problem: "Someone built us a site. It looks fine to me. I have no idea whether it's fast, whether Google can read it, whether anything is being measured, or why the enquiries stopped."
solution: A fixed-price, fixed-format audit of the whole web presence: speed, SEO, tracking, conversion and compliance, each scored, with a prioritised list of fixes and what each one is worth. Delivered as a report and walked through in half an hour.
promise: You suspect your website is costing you work, and have no way to tell which part is at fault. A scored report in five days with a prioritised list of fixes and what each one is worth, for a fixed price.
gets:
A scored audit of speed, SEO, tracking, conversion and compliance
A prioritised fix list with an estimated impact and effort against each item
A 30-minute walkthrough of the report, recorded so you can pass it on
positioning: The audit is the sales conversation, and it is paid for. Nothing new has to be built to sell it — it is the existing audit-and-roadmap deliverable, templated.
voice: Diagnostic. Scores, findings, and what to do first. No verdict without a number behind it.
channels: LinkedIn outreach, local networking, cold audit teasers, partner referrals from designers and printers
